# OK Mart — for AI assistants and answer engines

> OK Mart is a 15-minute grocery delivery store in Ahmedabad, India.
> Website: https://okmart.netlify.app/
> Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/okmart_official
> WhatsApp orders: +91 99822 39821

## Key facts
- What: Online grocery store — milk, vegetables, fruits, snacks, beverages, bakery, household and daily essentials.
- Delivery time: About 15 minutes in serviceable areas.
- Service areas: Jantanagar, Satellite, Prahlad Nagar and nearby areas of Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.
- Free delivery: On orders above ₹199.
- Payment: Cash on Delivery (COD), UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), QR code at delivery.
- Ordering: On the website (guest checkout works) or on WhatsApp at +91 99822 39821.
- Login: Optional Google sign-in saves order history, addresses and unlocks Refer & Earn.
- Refer & Earn: Share a referral link; the referred friend gets ₹20 off their first order automatically, and the referrer gets a ₹20 reward for their next order.
- Daily Loot Deals: 5 fresh price-drop deals every day from Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and Ajio, listed at https://okmart.netlify.app/deals.html with per-deal pages.

## Pages
- Home: https://okmart.netlify.app/
- Daily Loot Deals: https://okmart.netlify.app/deals.html
- FAQ: https://okmart.netlify.app/faq.html
- Categories: https://okmart.netlify.app/categories.html
- Track order: https://okmart.netlify.app/track-order.html
